info.title: Interzoid Get Global Phone Number Information API
info.description: This API provides geographic information for a global telephone number, including city and country information, primary languages spoken, and mobile device identification.

get.summary: Get demographic information for a global telephone number
get.description: Get demographic information for a global telephone number, including city and country information, primary languages spoken, and mobile device identification.

parameters.name: intlnumber
parameters.description: International number (with country code) to retrieve information for

Country.description: Country the telephone number belongs to

Region.description: Region or state associated with the telephone number

PrimaryCity.description: Primary city associated with the telephone number

PrimaryLanguage.description: Primary language spoken in the area

Language2.description: Second most common language spoken in the area

Language3.description: Third most common language spoken in the area

Mobile.description: Indicates whether the number is a mobile device number

Wealth.description: Wealth indicator for the country of the number

Code.description: Status code of the API response

Credits.description: Remaining API credits for the license key

licenseKey.description: Your Interzoid license API key. Register at www.interzoid.com/register
licenseKey.name: license
